verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a GPU cloud/ML platform, but the evidence pack never documents cron-style or recurring schedules. Paperspace Workflows are described only as automated ML pipelines, which is a one-off pipeline capability, not a recurring schedule. Auto-shutdown is an inactivity-based stop rule, an adjacent control rather than job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
